verdict.rationale: Whether customer data is used for AI model training is a fair privacy question for a SaaS card-issuing platform that processes cardholder and transaction data, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, data-usage controls, or any policy on model training. The evidence covers only card issuing, authorisation, disputes, 3DS and webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
